raw.text: A lamp (function) using LED technology only is deemed to comply with the intensity requirements at all points in time if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. of Annex 8 are compliant.

candidates.text: A lamp (function) using any other light generating technology shall comply with the corresponding intensity requirements from the point in time listed in Table A8-1 until photometric stability is reached.

raw.text: A lamp (function) using any other light generating technology shall comply with the corresponding intensity requirements from the point in time listed in Table A8-1 until photometric stability is reached.

candidates.text: A lamp (function) using more than one light generating technology shall comply with the corresponding intensity requirements following the strictest time requirements of paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. of Annex 8 for the combination.

raw.text: A lamp (function) using more than one light generating technology shall comply with the corresponding intensity requirements following the strictest time requirements of paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. of Annex 8 for the combination.

candidates.text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the lamp (function) shall comply with the corresponding minimum intensity requirements at all points in time starting at the point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
